ex: All dogs must be kept on a leash in public places.
在公共场所所有的狗必须用皮带牵住。

zh: 租用，租借，出租（尤指房地产或设备）
en: the act of using or letting somebody use something, especially property or equipment, in exchange for rent or a regular payment
ex: car leasing
汽车租赁

zh: 最小的；最少的；程度最轻的
en: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
ex: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
他虽然经验最少，却是最出色的老师。

zh: 大众化的东西；最平庸的人
en: the smallest number that the bottom numbers of a group of fractions can be divided into exactly
the smallest number that a group of numbers can be divided into exactly
used to limit or make what you have just said less definite
ex: It isn't cheap to get there, leastways not at this time of year.
去那里费用可不低，至少在一年中的这个时节是这样。

zh: （尤指骑摩托车人穿的）皮衣，皮外套
en: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes
ex: a leather jacket
皮夹克

en: a very large sea turtle with a shell that looks like leather
an artificial material that looks and feels like leather
that looks or feels hard and tough like leather
ex: leathery skin
粗糙的皮肤

zh: 离开居住地点（或群体、工作单位等）
en: to go away from a person or a place
ex: Come on, it's time we left (= time for us to leave).
快点，我们该走了。

en: to not consider something
ex: Leaving the expense aside, do we actually need a second car?
且不说费用多少，我们真的还需要一辆汽车吗？

zh: 比…取得好得多的进展；把…抛在后面；超过
永久离开（某人或某地）；永久脱离（某状态）
en: to make much better progress than somebody
ex: Britain is being left behind in the race for new markets.
英国在开拓新市场方面正被甩在后面。

en: to stop doing something
ex: Start reading from where you left off last time.
从上次停下来的地方接着读吧。

en: to not include or mention somebody/something in something
ex: Leave me out of this quarrel, please.
请别把我牵扯进这场争吵。

en: the act of saying goodbye
a substance, especially yeast, that is added to bread before it is cooked to make it rise
ex: A few jokes add leaven to a boring speech.
几句笑话可给枯燥无味的演讲增添活跃的气氛。

en: a person who is leaving a place
ex: school-leavers
中学毕业生

zh: the best-known collection of poems by the US poet Walt Whitman. They praise America and the free American man. The collection was first published in 1855 with 12 poems, and then eight more times with poems added each time until there were more than 130. They were not very popular during Whitman's life, but are now considered to have had a great influence on later US poetry.
en: the best-known collection of poems by the US poet Walt Whitman. They praise America and the free American man. The collection was first published in 1855 with 12 poems, and then eight more times with poems added each time until there were more than 130. They were not very popular during Whitman's life, but are now considered to have had a great influence on later US poetry.

zh: （不要的）剩余物（尤指剩余饭菜）
en: something that you leave because you do not want it, especially food

zh: 黎巴嫩人；黎巴嫩的；黎巴嫩人的
en: (a person) from Lebanon
a country in western Asia
a lecher (= a man who shows an unpleasant sexual interest in somebody)
a man who shows an unpleasant sexual interest in somebody
showing an unpleasant sexual interest in somebody
